'''Johnson''': {{legend0|#ffb2b2|40–50%}} {{legend0|#e27f7f|50–60%}} {{legend0|#D75D5D|60–70%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Chris Dodd]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Chris Dodd]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Connecticut}} The '''1992 United States Senate election in Connecticut''' took place on November 3, 1992, alongside other elections to the [[United States Senate]] in 34 other states, as well as with a [[1992 United States presidential election|presidential election]] and elections to the [[United States House of Representatives]] in all 50 states. Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] U.S. Senator [[Christopher Dodd]] won re-election for a third term. ==Major candidates== === Democratic === * [[Christopher Dodd]], incumbent U.S. Senator === Republican === * Brook Johnson, businessman * [[Christopher Burnham]], state representative == Campaign == Johnson, a millionaire businessman who had never run for public office before, spent about $900,000 during the primary campaign. His television and radio commercials said that he would bring "a dose of success Washington needs." Dodd had $2 million cash on hand following the primaries.{{Cite news | url=https://select.nytimes.com/gst/abstract.html?res=F1061EFF38590C758DDDA00894DA494D81 | archive-url=https://archive.today/20120723133103/http://select.nytimes.com/gst/abstract.html?res=F1061EFF38590C758DDDA00894DA494D81 | url-status=dead | archive-date=July 23, 2012 | work=The New York Times | first=Constance L. | last=Hays | title=THE 1992 CAMPAIGN: CONNECTICUT; Brook Johnson Captures Republican Senate Race | date=September 16, 1992 }} ==Results== {{Election box begin no change | title = Connecticut United States Senate election, 1992{{Cite web|url=http://www.ourcampaigns.com/RaceDetail.html?RaceID=3498 |title = CT US Senate |publisher=OurCampaigns.com | access-date=August 19, 2010}}}} {{Election box winning candidate with party link no change | party = Democratic Party (United States) | candidate = Christopher Dodd (incumbent) | votes = 882,569 | percentage = 58.81% }} {{Election box candidate with party link no change | party = Republican Party (United States) | candidate = Brook Johnson | votes = 572,036 | percentage = 38.12% }} {{Election box candidate with party link no change | party = Concerned Citizens Party | candidate = Richard D.
